science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: The interior of the first forge hummed with a chaotic vibrato as the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear rippled across the ferrofluid sea in the containment vat. Copper coils sparked with latent energy, casting warm, erratic shadows against the riveted brass bulkheads. Hector grinned, ignoring the ozone smell that always preceded a polarity shift, and tried to DEFEND the fragile induction array from the surging currents. He hoped to ATTRACT the excess voltage into the secondary grounding shunt, but the fluid's unpredictable viscosity threatened to CONSUME the delicate diagnostic tools entirely. He replaced the brass pressure-gauge bezel with an engraved 'Inefficient' dial plate. Before the main breaker tripped, he passed the warm copper calibration baton directly into Kaio's hands.
